question_text: A 36-year-old primigravida presents to her obstetrician for antenatal care. She is at 24 weeks of gestation and does not have any current complaint except for occasional leg cramps. She does not smoke or drink alcohol. Family history is irrelevant. Her temperature is 36.9°C (98.42°F), blood pressure is 100/60 mm Hg, and pulse of 95/minute. Her body mass index is 21 kg/m² (46 pounds/m²). Physical examination reveals a palpable uterus above the umbilicus with no other abnormalities. Which of the following screening tests is suitable for this patient?
